title: Architect's core extensions list (core-extensions.toml)
description: What the standard release of Architect includes, by reference: one [[core]] entry per extension, which lives in its own repo. Read and checked by `cargo xtask core` (xtask/src/core.rs), which applies these rules and more (one form per platform, unique ids, the tag naming the version) and keeps dist/standard generated from it.

platform.description: desktop: the app's window (Linux, macOS, Windows); node: `serve`, the headless node (share links, Sites); ios: the iPhone and iPad app; web: the hosted web app. dist/standard builds desktop and node today.

id.description: The extension's id, as its extension.toml says.

publisher.description: Who publishes it; their key signs its releases (`signature.key`).

source.description: The extension's own repository (a git URL).

tag.description: The git tag of that release in `source`; it names `version`.

rev.description: The commit the tag names: the linked form's digest (`cargo xtask core verify` checks the tag still names it; dist/standard's lock pins it).

signature.description: The publisher's signature over the release: its SHA256SUMS, signed with minisign.

key.description: `org` (the FastTrackStudios org release key) or the publisher's minisign public key (the base64 line of its .pub).

comment.description: The signature's trusted comment, exactly; it names the tag, so a signature lifted from another release is refused.

linked.description: Compiled into the standard build from its crate at `rev`.

extension.description: The Rust path of its `linked::Extension` value (`Distribution::linked`).

blocks.description: A function returning its block renderer for the node's share links and Sites (`Distribution::block`).

patch.description: Its repo's own [patch] tables the build must copy: a git URL to the crates of `source` (at `tag`) that replace it.

packaged.description: A file its release carries, fetched, checked and shipped beside the binary (`core/<id>/`).

folder.description: The folder taken from a .tar.gz archive (none: the archive is an .archext, not bundled yet).

island.description: The folder is a share-page island (`Distribution::island`): its views and stylesheet.
